downballot_2006.name: The Downballot, Presidential results by congressional district, 2006-2010 lines (2008, 2004, 2000)
downballot_2006.licence: none printed on the sheets; The Downballot's own calculations from official precinct results
downballot_2006.note: calculated by The Downballot from official precinct results; methodology https://docs.google.com/document/d/1efGEHGAQGaDGnIrdedwxVg1uUrjZYz06IPLTHRCg9zM; sha256 cabd4860a9e7d8ac

house_history.name: History, Art & Archives, U.S. House of Representatives, Party Divisions of the House of Representatives, 1789 to Present
house_history.licence: a publication of the U.S. House; no licence printed

chamber.rule: 218 of 435 seats (a majority of the whole House)
chamber.seat_model: y_i = mean_i + swing_loading_i * d + e_i, d ~ N(0, common_swing_sd^2), e_i ~ N(0, own_sd_i^2), each seat's stage_two.inputs giving mean, own_sd, swing_loading

model.what: the model's own forecast (data/congress/REPORT.md section 2), fitted on earlier cycles only, from what was known before the election (the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 05:58); no polls are used, so it carries less than forecasters then knew

calibration.note: not calibrated: 1 earlier year(s) scored out of sample, 3 needed

model.sd_is: sqrt(national_sd^2 + s_e^2); national_sd = k s_a sqrt(1 + z (Z'Z)^-1 z'), s_e = k s_e_fitted, z = (1, midterm * P, (1 - midterm) * P), P = +1 Democratic president, -1 Republican; k the calibration factor

variant.note: the mean as fitted, normal tails first (no variant of round 5 passed its test for this level; REPORT 2.7)

near_tie.note: a factor by band of |mean - 1/2| (band_from up to the next band's start): each forecast's own calibration gives its multiplier of p; a band whose fitting years expected fewer than 30 near-ties has none (REPORT 2.6, 2.7)

national_from.note: national terms from the Senate's earlier cycles: c, s_a and (Z'Z)^-1 are the Senate's fit on its own cycles before this year, since the House has fewer than four earlier cycles of its own (the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 06:36, item 2)

fte_538.version_note: 538 showed one version by default; no source read here names it, so the version listed first in its repository's rows comes first and the others stand beside it (the orchestrator, 04:12)
